Close to the Hebrew; “why does His hand not turn aside” is rendered “why His hand is not removed.”
NASB reorders the answer, placing “according to the number of the lords” after the gold objects. “On all of them” is rendered “on all of you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lighten His hand” is rendered “ease His hand.”
“Heart” (singular) is rendered “hearts,” and “Egypt” as “the Egyptians”; NASB supplies “the people” as those sent away.
“Nursing cows” is rendered “milch cows,” and “take back their young ones home” as “take their calves home, away from them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “into the cart” is rendered “on the cart.”
NASB supplies “by” and “then,” and makes the chance clause a separate sentence; the sense is close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB joins the box with its contents (“the box with the golden mice”); the Hebrew lists each item with its own object marker.
NASB smooths the repeated “road … highway” wording; “lowing as they went” renders “went and lowed.”
“Beth-shemesh were harvesting” is rendered “the people of Beth-shemesh,” and NASB adds “their.”
